newsitem.title: TAJIKISTAN: Tajik government says may use force to free hostages.
newsitem.headline: Tajik government says may use force to free hostages.

text.p: The Tajik government said in an ultimatum on Sunday it might use force to free 11 Western and Russian hostages held by a group of Islamic rebels if the captives were not released by 1030 local time (0530 GMT). There was no further information as the deadline passed.

"If by 1030 local time the rebels do not free the hostages, the government side will use force. All peaceful means to settle the crisis have already been tried. The moral responsibility for possible consequences of the action will rest with the Sadirov brothers," presidential spokesman Zafar Saidov told Reuters.
